scripts.release:check: node -e "try { const url = new URL(process.env.TEST_DATABASE_URL || ''); if (!['postgres:', 'postgresql:'].includes(url.protocol) || !['localhost', '127.0.0.1', '[::1]'].includes(url.hostname) || url.pathname !== '/careiq_test' || url.search || url.hash) throw new Error(); } catch { console.error('Set TEST_DATABASE_URL to an isolated loopback PostgreSQL careiq_test database before release checks.'); process.exit(1); }" && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm security:regressions && pnpm web:associations:test && pnpm --fail-if-no-match --filter ./apps/web test:browser && pnpm test:browser:api && pnpm security:audit
